reason: The finding's load-bearing premise — that Bukkit/Paper leaves a plugin enabled when onEnable throws, so line 206 is skipped and all commands die — is false on the platform this plugin targets. Disassembling Paper 1.21.4 (versions/1.21.4/paper-1.21.4.jar, io.papermc.paper.plugin.manager.PaperPluginInstanceManager#enablePlugin) shows the `JavaPlugin.setEnabled(true)` call wrapped in `catch (Throwable)`; the handler logs 'Error occurred while enabling ...' and then calls `PluginManager.disablePlugin(plugin)`, which logs 'Disabling', fires PluginDisableEvent and clears isEnabled, so PluginCommand.execute short-circuits with 'Cannot execute command ... plugin is disabled' rather than silently serving a half-bound command. The repo itself encodes this contract at HilltopVillagePlugin.java:236 ('onDisable 可能在 onEnable 早期失败后执行，故必须判空'). Second, even under the hypothetical enabled state, plugin.yml omitting `executor:` does not kill command dispatch: PluginCommand's package constructor stores the owning Plugin in its `executor` field (verified in paper-api 1.21.4 bytecode, `putfield executor` from the Plugin argument), and HilltopVillagePlugin overrides onCommand at lines 582-584 delegating to commandHandler.handle, so at worst tab completion would be unbound — not '/hilltop start/stop/enable/disable/join/gui/reloadconfig all unreachable'. A genuine throw path does exist (ShopConfigLoader.load throws IllegalStateException on a quarantined/shop.items-not-a-map shop.yml at ShopConfigLoader.java:98, :110, :125, invoked from ShopManager.reload at ShopManager.java:56, called uncaught at HilltopVillagePlugin.java:120), but the demonstrated outcome is a disabled plugin with a console SEVERE trace — precisely the stated design at HilltopVillagePlugin.java:103-104 ('核心模块初始化失败就应当让启动失败并禁用插件') — and the other cited callees mostly swallow or guard their own failures (ArenaManager.load per-arena try/catch at ArenaManager.java:188, unusable-yml read-only degradation at :135-140, world-load catch at :243-245; NpcManager.spawnNpc returning false on a null world at NpcManager.java:71). The impact the finding claims is therefore not reachable, and the surviving behaviour is by design.
